D2_rtl.note: Delegated review of work/rtl_gen.md: clean at the first attempt (0 errors, 0 warnings; 1 note: the simulation-only $error on illegal parameters; 1 waiver for the ignored prot and address bits). Registered outputs, every flop reset, single clock, no CDC; 141/193 rules tagged. The 7 open points follow the specification. OPEN, not resolved by this approval: REQ-IMP-001 timing. ABC estimates the longest combinational path at 16.9 ns (TT) and 31.5 ns (SS 125 C) against a 20 ns period; likely the serial OR-chain read mux and the 32-bit decode compare. Not a sign-off STA figure, but it must be decided by the designer at G4. Correctness is left to the verification. Not a hardware designer's review.
